says: The tests step added a new function, viPlant, which builds VI_METHODS and VI_PROPERTIES from one table, but the approved plan has no ## Existing tools section, so the search 0587 asks for each new helper is not recorded.
proof: grep -n 'Existing tools' docs/plan/quests/mock-oxlint-plugins-PLAN.md prints nothing, while builtin-plants.ts:139 reads `const viPlant = (code: string, pick: (line: (typeof VI_LOCK)[number]) => boolean): Plant => ({`. nice -n 19 rg -n '\): Plant =>|=> Plant' oxlint-plugins/ finds only this line and two test-local factories in runs-from-depth.test.ts:182,188, so no existing helper was missed.
cost: Low: no copy was made, but a later reader cannot see that a search was done, and plancheck cannot catch a new function inside an existing file.
